data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 开场前的零钱盒
data.description: STARRY开门前，虹夏把找零的钱币分进小格，抬头确认你手里的票。吧台后的灯刚亮，鼓点还没从排练室传出来。
data.promptProse: Before the doors open at STARRY, Nijika wears a red band T-shirt and black pleated midi skirt behind the ticket counter. She sorts coins into a small cash tray, looking up toward the viewer. Warm counter lamps light her hands and the quiet entrance.
data.animaCaption: The coins remain in the cash tray beneath her hands; no readable ticket text is required.
data.action: 把找零硬币分入零钱盒，抬头确认来客
